name: Ernest Rutherford
summary: Physicist and chemist known as the founder of nuclear science and discoverer of the atomic nucleus.

name: Niels Bohr
summary: Physicist who developed the Bohr model of the atom and a close collaborator of Rutherford.

name: University of Manchester
summary: University where Rutherford worked before moving to Cambridge.

name: Cavendish Laboratory
summary: Physics laboratory at Cambridge University where Rutherford served as professor.

name: University of Cambridge
summary: University where Rutherford succeeded J. J. Thomson as Cavendish professor.

name: University of Copenhagen
summary: University where Niels Bohr established his institute for theoretical physics.

name: Physical Society
summary: Organization that hosted the Rutherford Memorial Lecture.

name: atomic nucleus
summary: Central part of the atom discovered by Rutherford.

name: Philosophical Magazine
summary: Journal where Rutherford published his papers on nuclear disintegrations.

name: Proceedings of the Physical Society
summary: Journal where the Rutherford Memorial Lecture was published.

name: J. J. Thomson
summary: Physicist and predecessor of Rutherford as Cavendish professor.

name: George Hevesy
summary: Chemist who worked with Rutherford and developed the tracer method.

name: James Chadwick
summary: Physicist and collaborator of Rutherford who discovered the neutron.

name: Henry Moseley
summary: Physicist who worked with Rutherford and established atomic numbers.

name: John Cockcroft
summary: Physicist who collaborated with Rutherford on particle acceleration.
